title: Coastal marine eutrophication footprint of reactive nitrogen: global emission-to-impact model chain and GLORIA MRIO satellites (2015-2022)

creators.name: Berthet, Etienne
creators.affiliation: MIT Center for Sustainability Science and Strategy, Massachusetts Institute of Technology

creators.name: Morris, Jennifer
creators.affiliation: MIT Center for Sustainability Science and Strategy, Massachusetts Institute of Technology

description:
Global model chain and dataset quantifying the coastal marine eutrophication footprint of reactive nitrogen (2015–2022) — from nitrogen emissions, through spatially explicit fate and effect modelling, to the final consumption ultimately driving the impacts. Three pathways are covered: agricultural leaching of waterborne N, airborne NH3 and airborne NOx. Impacts are expressed in kg O2-eq (marine oxygen depletion) and resolved to 305 coastal Large Marine Ecosystem sub-segments (cLME-ss), with the emitting country and driving activity (crops, grazing, IPCC sectors) attached; they are then harmonised into one comparable database, converted into GLORIA v60 MRIO satellite matrices (305 LME rows × 39,360 region-sector columns per year and substance), and traced to final demand with a Leontief demand-pull model — including product-level detail for seven coral-reef LME sub-segments.

Underlying models and data. The framework builds on and couples: the spatially differentiated marine-eutrophication assessment models of Cosme & Hauschild (2017), Cosme, Mayorga & Hauschild (2018) and Vea et al. (2022, 2024), with atmospheric characterisation following Bjørn et al. (2020); the IMAGE-GNM global nutrient model (Beusen et al., 2015; Beusen & Bouwman, 2022) for soil nitrogen budgets; EDGAR v8.1 gridded NH3/NOx emissions (Crippa et al., 2024); the crop-specific nitrogen fertilisation dataset of Adalibieke et al. (2023); and the GLORIA global environmentally-extended MRIO database, release 060 (University of Sydney IELab; cf. Lenzen et al., 2013; Malik et al., 2022). Full citations are in the record's reference list and in the archived README.

Contents. Shared GIS layers and grid–LME correspondences; the crop and grazing leaching pipelines; the NH3/NOx emission preparation and impact pipelines (including the CF-matrix builders CF_NHx.m / CF_NOx.m); the harmonised all-pathway database (Parquet); the GLORIA v60 satellite builder with label, exclusion and conservation reports; and the MATLAB MRIO scripts for production- and consumption-based accounts. Every pipeline is a single linear, cell-structured script with built-in conservation checks; PIPELINE.md documents the execution order and run_pipeline.bat runs the whole chain. Modelling choices a reviewer should see are flagged REVIEW in scripts and reports. Units: kg O2-eq; emissions in kg (NOx as NO2); releases also normalised to kg N.

Not redistributed (in-archive pointer files explain exactly how to obtain each): the TPDC crop-specific fertilisation HDF5 files (personal download credentials; doi:10.11888/Terre.tpdc.300446), the IMAGE-GNM budget netCDFs (INMS data portal, registered users), and the GLORIA core matrices (IELab registration). Third-party data remain under their original licenses and citation requirements.
